messages:
amanda: Quick sync — after the routing-policy telemetry changes landed, a few Dedicated console builds started failing at webpack time (duplicate types from two telemetry versions). Any short-term plan?
li: Do we have a minimal repro? Bundle errors or runtime?
amanda: Build-time. Example: "Duplicate identifier 'TelemetryEvent'" during tsc + webpack. Repro gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/console-telemetry-repro
omar: Two things: 1) short-term vendor a single telemetry impl into the console canary to unblock customers, 2) medium-term publish a compatibility shim package that unifies v2/v3 types for SDKs.
nate: For TS/JS, shim + peerDependency is safer. SDKs depend on @redwood/telemetry-compat, which re-exports a stable interface. Console can opt into a concrete telemetry implementation (v2 or v3) as a peer dep. That avoids long-term pinning.
li: For Python we can mirror with a tiny package redwood_telemetry_compat that lazy-imports v2 or v3 and provides no-op fallbacks if missing. Keeps pip installs non-breaking.
amanda: Agree. We should also add a CI bundling test that runs a build with both telemetry versions present to catch duplicates early.
omar: UX note: in console rollout we should show a small banner in the Console settings when telemetry is mismatched: "Detected telemetry runtime mismatch — see docs" with a link. Helps customers who vendor their own deps.
nate: Action items: Nate -> TS shim scaffold + minimal tests, Li -> Py shim scaffold, Omar -> console canary alias and CI bundling test, Amanda -> customer comms + support tickets.
devex-bot: reminder set for 3 days to check canary metrics :calendar:
amanda: Plan timeline: ship shims (48h), deploy console canary with vendorized telemetry (emergency only), bump SDKs to depend on compat shim (minor), monitor for 2 weeks.
li: I'll include example install snippets for consumers and a short note about peerDependency warnings.
omar: PR titles: "telemetry-compat: TS shim", "telemetry-compat: Py shim", "console: alias telemetry -> compat + bundle test". I'll link them once created.
amanda: Thanks — let's avoid instructing customers to pin telemetry unless we need a hard rollback. Keep vendorization as last resort.
